prompts.title: 身穿正装的电影特写
prompts.description: Nano Banana Pro (v.037) 的一个提示，描述了一个身穿深色定制西装、姿势严肃的主体的电影特写镜头。它指定了高对比度照明，带有暖金色主光和冷青绿色环境背光，背景中有华丽的金色烛台，以及强烈的焦外虚化。
prompts.content: "Image from subject, cinematic close-up, centered subject with head tilted downward in a somber pose. Wearing a dark tailored formal suit, matching dress shirt, and necktie. Background filled with ornate gold candelabras and flickering candles; blurred foreground elements create depth. High-contrast lighting featuring warm golden key light and cool cyan-green ambient backlight. Saturated orange highlights and deep teal-tinted shadows. Shallow depth of field, heavy bokeh, and fine cinematic film grain. Artistic interpretation, prioritize the camera angle, lighting scheme, and color grading over realistic skin tones."
prompts.translatedContent: 主体图像，电影特写镜头，主体居中，头部向下倾斜，姿态忧郁。身穿深色定制正装西服，搭配同色系正装衬衫和领带。背景布满华丽的金色烛台和闪烁的蜡烛；前景模糊元素营造出景深。高对比度照明，暖金色主光和冷青绿色环境背光。饱和的橙色高光和深青色调的阴影。浅景深，强烈的焦外虚化，以及细腻的电影胶片颗粒。艺术化诠释，优先考虑摄像机角度、照明方案和色彩分级，而非真实的肤色。

Her striking green eyes have long lashes and dark, full eyebrows. prompts.content:
[{argument name="Brand Name" default="BRAND NAME"}]

[{argument name="Product Type" default="PRODUCT TYPE"}] (Clothing / Food / Automotive / Tech).

Goal: Generate a professional "scrapbook" style collage poster for [{argument name="Brand Name" default="BRAND NAME"}] centered around a [{argument name="Product Type" default="PRODUCT TYPE"}].

1. HERO PRODUCT (BOTTOM FOCUS)

- Object: A high-definition, realistic 3D render of a [{argument name="Product Type" default="PRODUCT TYPE"}] by [{argument name="Brand Name" default="BRAND NAME"}] at the bottom center.

- Placement: Slightly angled to show depth, with soft realistic contact shadows on a plain off-white floor.

2. THE MULTI-LAYERED COLLAGE STACK

- Photos: A vertical stack of overlapping photos with RAGGED, TORN paper edges rising above the product.

- Content: Photos should show [{argument name="Product Type" default="PRODUCT TYPE"}] in use, lifestyle shots related to [{argument name="Brand Name" default="BRAND NAME"}], and close-ups of specific details.

Design a modern graphic poster titled “Chill-out.” The man wears a red hoodie, black cuffed joggers, red and white Air Jordan high-top sneakers, dark sunglasses, and silver rings. Background is matte textured black. Large bold white sans-serif text “chill” and “out” forms a bench-like structure, with “chill” underlined. Add orange circles, squares, thin white grid lines, and phrases: “Life is so much easier when you just chill-out” and “Less stress, more chill.”

The chattering teeth stand inside an overflowing toy box made of painted wood, its interior cluttered with colorful toys—tiny cars, sparkling plastic jewelry, wrapped candies, rubber balls, and scattered trinkets—some spilling over the edge. Soft, diffused lighting creates gentle shadows and a cozy, nostalgic atmosphere, with a shallow depth of field subtly blurring the background toys to keep the focus on the animated chattering teeth and feet.
